publisherComparison.status: Research-only robustness follow-up; historical first comparison preserved
publisherComparison.method: Same fixed archive crop, nine diagnostic grid/resampler combinations, all eight right-angle/reflection candidates. In-memory only; no image files written. Grid counts are image-index diagnostics, not angular or physical terrain-scale computations.
publisherComparison.visualInspection: Both unchanged complete images inspected. Distinctive central angular boulder and surrounding blocks/shadow pattern correspond with a vertical reflection of the archive browse patch. Neither image depicts the complete body limb.
publisherComparison.interpretation: All nine best candidates are quarter-turn2 then horizontal reflection, algebraically equivalent to a vertical reflection. Strong content association does not establish exact NASA production history, resampling, photometric stretch or original acquisition-file lineage.
limits: Similarity is a content-association diagnostic, not exact source lineage, pixel equality, calibrated I/F or photometry.
Crop support is a stored image-index diagnostic, not a physical terrain footprint, angular/raster scale, dated scene registration, body frame or complete limb.
No image output, native alteration, embedding, catalogue/model/shape/codec change or new dossier. Original publisher and archive files retained unchanged.
No independently reproduced body-frame/ecliptic orientation or terrain registration. No claim that correlation calibrates image colour or physical pixel scale.

archiveStoredValueComparison.status: Research-only calibrated FITS to archive browse stored-value diagnostic; no production changes
archiveStoredValueComparison.method: Read original1024square big-endian float32 I/F array at byte23040. Reverse stored row order for XML bottom-to-top display convention and compare unchanged PNG pixels. Select finite nonnegative samples below1E8 and excluding PXOUTWIN. No physical/angular/raster-scale calculation.
archiveStoredValueComparison.xmlAssociation: XML explicitly names both FITS and browse PNG and describes browse product PNG created from DRACO IoverF calibrated fits file. Product local_identifier retains _01 while file names retain _02.
limits: A scalar relationship or monotonicity is a stored-value diagnostic, not an independently reproduced archive browse algorithm, absolute photometric accuracy or calibrated visible RGB.
Selection predicate does not independently validate samples or detector quality; excluded flags are not terrain.
NASA985square content comparison is a separate diagnostic; no exact production lineage, body-frame registration, geography or pixel equality follows.
No image output, native alteration, new embedding/dossier, model/map/shape/catalogue/codec change or pipeline execution.

interpretation: Strong content association supports the same observed patch. Vertical reflection describes only the tested display-array relation; it is not a body-frame/ecliptic registration or a recommended change to preserved publisher pixels.
